narrowings_added.span: the observation at which the magnitude of its rate of change of heading first rose above the onset yaw rate
narrowings_added.why: The count is anchored to the latest observation at which that magnitude rose above the onset yaw rate (false at the observation before, true there), not to the first such rise of the recording: the contract's own extent fixes this, since "the count runs on until the angle is reached or a later onset starts it again". "First" is therefore read as the first rise of the run the count belongs to.

narrowings_added.span: while the road user's footprint overlaps a way
narrowings_added.why: Read at the observation the concept speaks about — the one at which the angle is reached, and each later one at which the accumulated change still holds it — and not as a condition required at every observation from the onset onwards; the contract makes the overlap a circumstance of the reversal it recognizes, not a further bound on the manoeuvre's course.
